messages.author: 9e91c6dd0997c4b7
messages.subject: Loading FD
parts:
Hi all,

I was trying to do BSM, but when I loaded FD, i encountered the message below. 

==================================================================
Loading required package: ade4
Loading required package: ape
Loading required package: geometry
Loading required package: magic
Loading required package: abind
Loading required package: vegan
Loading required package: permute
Loading required package: lattice
This is vegan 2.4-2

Attaching package: ‘vegan’

The following object is masked from ‘package:ade4’:

    cca

Warning messages:
1: package ‘ade4’ was built under R version 3.3.2 
2: package ‘vegan’ was built under R version 3.3.2

==================================================================

How ill I address this issue....

Thank you,
Juliet

messages.author: 0e713d20fc7459b5
messages.subject: Re: Loading FD
parts:
Hi Juliet,

Don't worry, a warning is not an error.

The first messages simply tell you that a R function named cca exist in the packages vegan and ade4. In order to avoid conflicts, you can only call one of them directly. Typically the one of the first loaded package. 

The second message says that you are using an older or newer R version than the one used to create the packages. If the difference in your installed version and the one used to build the packages is not large, I would not worry much about it.

Cheers!
